standard.summary: 梯度检查点会少保存一部分中间激活，反向传播时再重算它们。
standard.effect: 通常能明显降低显存峰值，代价是训练速度下降。
standard.whenToUse: 显存吃紧、batch 上不去、分辨率较高或经常 OOM 时优先开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足且追求速度时可以关闭，尤其是短测和快速调参阶段。

standard_en.summary: Gradient checkpointing keeps fewer intermediate activations and recomputes them during backward.
standard_en.effect: It usually lowers the memory peak markedly, at the cost of training speed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on first when VRAM is tight, the batch will not grow, resolution is high, or you OOM often.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave it off when VRAM is plentiful and speed matters, especially during short tests and quick parameter sweeps.

advanced.principle: 反向传播需要 forward 阶段保存 activation。Checkpointing 通过少存 activation、backward 时重算局部 forward 来交换显存和计算量。
advanced.intervention: 介入模型 forward/backward 的 activation 保存策略，不改变训练目标。
advanced.expectedImpact: 主要降低 activation 显存峰值；对 LoRA 权重显存帮助较小，对高分辨率和 DiT block 更明显。
advanced.tradeoffs: 会增加计算开销；与 offload、compile、CUDAGraph 等策略组合时需要短测确认。

advanced_en.principle: Backward needs the activations saved during forward. Checkpointing trades compute for memory by saving fewer activations and recomputing local forward segments during backward.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes in the activation-saving policy of model forward/backward; does not change the training objective.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Mainly lowers the activation-VRAM peak; less help for LoRA weight VRAM, most visible at high resolution and on DiT blocks.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Adds compute; short-test when combined with offload, compile, CUDAGraph, and similar strategies.
